title: Repeat, now with repeat()
prompt: Same task, using the built-in repeat method on the string.
signature: func solve(text: String, times: int) -> String:
starter:
func solve(text: String, times: int) -> String:
	return text
hint: One call, one argument: how many times.
solution:
func solve(text: String, times: int) -> String:
	return text.repeat(times)
